title: Upgrade costs
description: Memory leveling costs by rarity (data/upgrade_costs.json). One bracket row per ten levels: the EXP to level through the bracket and the gold/crystals paid when the card reaches the bracket end ('to') to move on. The last row is the awakening payment at level 80; its gold/crystals unlock nothing further, 'heart' is the Awakening Heart rarity ('n'/'r'/'sr' crystal fields are omitted when the cost is zero). Values follow the community ascension calculator spreadsheet.

expPerLevel.description: EXP to advance from level N to N+1, index N-1 (levels 1..79; level 80 is the cap)
